text: No, the whole property was not cleared in 2021. Only about 81.3 hectares of tree cover were lost, which represents approximately 2.23% of the total asset area of 3643.5 hectares. This loss was primarily in planted forests, with no native forest loss detected. The loss was mapped by Hansen/UMD and corroborated by other data sources. However, the cause or legality of the loss is not established by this evidence.
